scores.tell: Candelabra brass is uniformly glossy gold with smooth gradients and no matte patches; wax is clean and plasticky.
Painterly smeared AI look. Grass is spiky brush marks, water is soft blur, and the rings are one lacquered gloss, unlike the real smooth 3D finish.
Wagon wood has painted-on grain and brush noise. The canvas is smooth, and the wheels and grass are painterly, so it reads as illustration, not a modeled surface.
Glossy plastic-like phone booth with smeared reflections on the glass and painterly noise. Metal hinges and plastic share one sheen.
Water caustics and sand are painterly with fine noisy detail. Wood posts have soft streaky marks. The rope is fairly good but the overall surface is illustrated, not smooth 3D.
none; the soft matte rubber has a gentle sheen, with a small gloss range between the two fin materials.
Leather gloves have a believable soft sheen and fold creases. The wood floor is a bit flat, and the gloss is slightly even across the red.
Slight uniformity: every dot on the sandals has the same soft sheen, but the rubber finish is a good match.
Boot leather is smooth and matte-satin with a soft highlight. It lacks stitching or seam detail, and the spur is clean gold.
Straw bristles have a soft sheen with only light strand lines. The handle is smooth wood with no grain. Surfaces are close to the real cards.
